name: ecuc-diff-builtin-parity
title: Match the ECUC diff content body to VS Code's built-in diff
description: The shipped Monaco diff page renders a pre-aligned synthetic row document with custom placeholders, fills and merge arrows, so its content body does not behave like VS Code's built-in diff editor. Investigate the gap against the VS Code/Monaco diff editor, decide whether to keep the synthetic semantic document or move to real file text with semantic metadata, and plan visual/interaction parity plus independently verifiable child tasks.
creator: --help
